associations.rationale: The formal type directly gives the induced sign representation as isomorphic to the biproduct of signRep and rotRep, one of the three claimed decompositions.
The formal type directly gives the induced trivial representation as isomorphic to the biproduct of trivRep and stdRep, one of the three claimed decompositions.
The formal type directly gives the induced standard representation as isomorphic to twoDimRep plus stdRep and rotRep, the third claimed decomposition.
